class.name: OpenXRMeshTracker
class.brief_description: Spatial entity tracker for our spatial entity mesh tracking extension.
class.description: Spatial entity tracker for our OpenXR spatial entity mesh tracking extension. These trackers contain mesh data that provide information about the environment around us.

method.name: clear_mesh_data
method.description: Clears the mesh data for this tracker. You should only call this if you are handling your own discovery logic.

method.name: get_index_buffer_id
method.description: Returns the buffer id for the index buffer provided through [method set_index_buffer]. This allows checking if indices are unchanged and skip an expensive pull of data.

method.name: get_indices
method.description: Gets the index data for the mesh.

method.name: get_mesh
method.description: Gets a mesh created from the mesh data provided by the runtime. This mesh is cached and will return the same resource when called while vertex, normal and index data remains unchanged.

method.name: get_mesh_adjusted_offset
method.description: Returns our mesh offset but with world scale applied.

method.name: get_normal_buffer_id
method.description: Returns the buffer id for the normal buffer provided through [method set_normal_buffer]. This allows checking if normals are unchanged and skip an expensive pull of data.

method.name: get_normals
method.description: Gets the normal data for the mesh.

method.name: get_shape
method.description: Gets a collision shape built from the mesh data. This shape is cached and will return the same object until new source data is provided.

method.name: get_vertex_buffer_id
method.description: Returns the buffer id for the vertex buffer provided through [method set_vertex_buffer]. This allows checking if vertices are unchanged and skip an expensive pull of data.

method.name: get_vertices
method.description: Gets the vertex data for the mesh.

method.name: set_index_buffer
method.description: Sets the buffer containing indices for our mesh data. Providing a value for [param buffer_id] allows you to check if OpenXR has supplied a new buffer on updates. [param is_counter_clockwise] specifies if data is in counter clockwise order (the default for OpenXR) and triggers a conversion to clockwise.

method.name: set_normal_buffer
method.description: Sets the buffer containing normals for our mesh data. Providing a value for [param buffer_id] allows you to check if OpenXR has supplied a new buffer on updates.

method.name: set_vertex_buffer
method.description: Sets the buffer containing vertices for our mesh data. Providing a value for [param buffer_id] allows you to check if OpenXR has supplied a new buffer on updates.

members.member: The bounding size of the mesh. This is a 3D size.
Mesh offset from our tracked pose.

signal.name: mesh_changed
signal.description: Emitted when our mesh data has changed the mesh instance and collision needs to be updated.
